mapper.select: SELECT pay52_favorite_account_id AS favorite_account_id, pay52_account_code_id AS account_code_id, pay52_seq AS seq, pay52_account_cd AS account_code, pay52_account_nm AS account_name, pay52_attribute_cd AS attribute_code, f_cdnm('AccountAttributeCode', pay52_attribute_cd, pay52_company_id, f_today()) AS attribute_name FROM ( SELECT pay52_favorite_account.* , act01_account_cd AS pay52_account_cd , act01_account_nm AS pay52_account_nm , act01_attribute_cd AS pay52_attribute_cd FROM pay52_favorite_account INNER JOIN act01_account_code ON act01_account_code_id = pay52_account_code_id WHERE pay52_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(act01_use_yn ,'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(act01_slip_yn,'false') = 'true' AND #{allAccountYn} = false UNION ALL SELECT row_number() over() AS pay52_favorite_account_id , act01_company_id AS pay52_company_id , act01_account_code_id AS pay52_account_code_id , CAST(act01_account_cd AS NUMERIC) AS pay52_seq , act01_account_cd AS pay52_account_cd , act01_account_nm AS pay52_account_nm , act01_attribute_cd AS pay52_attribute_cd FROM act01_account_code WHERE act01_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(act01_use_yn ,'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(act01_slip_yn,'false') = 'true' AND #{allAccountYn} = true ) t WHERE pay52_attribute_cd LIKE #{attributeCode} AND CONCAT(pay52_account_cd, pay52_account_nm) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY pay52_seq, pay52_attribute_cd, pay52_account_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay52_favorite_account ( pay52_favorite_account_id, pay52_company_id, pay52_account_code_id ) VALUES ( #{favoriteAccountId}, #{companyId}, #{accountCodeId} )
